newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: ALPINE SKIING-MEN'S ALPINE RACES RESCHEDULED.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-MEN'S ALPINE RACES RESCHEDULED.

text.p: A men's alpine World Cup super giant slalom has been added to the program at Chamonix, France, on January 10, the International Ski Federation said on Saturday.
The super-g originally scheduled for December 8 in Whistler, B.C. was postponed because of too much snow at the Canadian resort.
The rescheduled race will be part of a busy weekend at the French resort which will also stage a downhill and a slalom on January 11 and 12.
The downhill and slalom will also make up the first combined event of the season.

The FIS has also informed the organisers of a men's slalom and giant slalom scheduled for Jan 5 and 6 in Kranska Gora, Slovenia, that the races will move to Veysonnaz, Switzerland, if the course is not ready by December 30.
